meta.note: Every source below was reached and read during this session unless the 'accessed' field says otherwise. Tier 1 = league-official or government-official. Tier 2 = primary issuer / regulated operator publication. Tier 3 = community, NOT official - never used to populate a value, only referenced as a methodology note.

sources.name: NFL.com — Official Injury Report (Week 10, 2026)
sources.used_for: Week 10 practice participation (DNP / Limited / Full) and game status (Out / Doubtful / Questionable) for all players listed; per-matchup team records.
sources.notes: Page title read: 'Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season'. Contains 14 matchups.

sources.name: NFL.com — 2026 Division Standings
sources.used_for: All 32 team records, points for/against, home/road/division/conference splits, streak.
sources.notes: Reflects completion of Week 9. The Week 10 Thursday game (8:15 PM ET) had not kicked off at retrieval time.

sources.name: NFL.com — News (lineup / injury news)
sources.used_for: Confirmed quarterback and lineup changes that are absent from the injury report.
sources.notes: Headlines read directly from the official NFL.com injury page news rail.

sources.name: NFL Football Operations
sources.used_for: Attempted lookup of the written injury-reporting policy.
sources.notes: INCONCLUSIVE: the specific policy pages attempted (gameday/nfl-game-status, inside-football-ops/health-and-safety/injury-report) returned HTTP 404. No official policy text was confirmed. See flag F-007.

sources.name: NFL Next Gen Stats
sources.used_for: Prospective tracking-data input for prop modelling (separation, completion probability, rush yards over expected).
sources.notes: NOT READ this session. No historical series was ingested. Any value attributed to NGS is marked unverified.

sources.name: Genius Sports — NFL exclusive official data & Watch & Bet distribution partner
sources.publisher: Genius Sports Limited (NYSE: GENI) / Business Wire
sources.used_for: Establishes the only league-authorised wholesale path for official NFL play-by-play, Next Gen Stats and the official sports-betting data feed.
sources.notes: Release dated 6 July 2023. States the extended exclusive partnership runs through the end of the 2027-28 season and that Genius powers over 98% of the legalised U.S. sports betting market with official NFL data.

sources.name: Nevada Gaming Control Board — Gaming Revenue Report
sources.publisher: State of Nevada, Gaming Control Board
sources.used_for: Sports pool hold percentage (the book's structural edge) — the baseline a strategy must beat.
sources.notes: Monthly report read via the Board's own PDF series. Nevada statewide sports pool hold: 7.72% for the reported month and 6.06% fiscal-year-to-date (May 2025 report, figures in thousands: win $41,158 and $449,816 respectively). Used to size the vig hurdle.

sources.name: NOAA / National Weather Service
sources.publisher: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
sources.used_for: Prospective official weather input for totals and kicking props.
sources.notes: NOT READ this session. No value populated from it.

sources.name: nflverse / nfl-data-py
sources.used_for: Referenced only as a candidate convenience mirror for historical play-by-play. NOT used to populate any value.
sources.notes: A community redistribution of official NFL data. Treated as non-authoritative: any field sourced here must be re-checked against SRC-001/SRC-002 or left blank.
